contamination_guard: This amendment was written before running the population probe and before materializing any population or cohort identity. Its rules are fully specified from prior schema/contract semantics.

contrast_matching.anchor_assignment: The 14 evaluation controls are ordered by frozen source_rank/mint/creator. Contrast slots cycle through control ordinals modulo 14 without using outcome data.
contrast_matching.insufficient_candidates: Fail closed with HOLD_P3R_S2B_CONTRAST_CONFOUND; do not rebalance quotas or hand-pick replacements.
contrast_matching.missing_values: Use -1 exactly as specified; no null ordering is discretionary.
contrast_matching.neutrality: Classes and matching features are pre-defined source properties. No detector result, canonical label in detector input, or observed candidate identity changes the rule.
contrast_matching.ordering: Within the first non-empty ladder level, use source_rank ASC, mint ASC, create_creator ASC; skip already selected and evaluation-truth members.

scope: schema-and-contract semantics only; no population, control, or contrast identities were read to create this amendment

source_rank.independent_dimension_count: count of ep3_topology, timing, migration_actor, behaviour booleans
source_rank.neutrality: Ranks retained local evidence completeness only; it uses no control label, operation membership, contrast class, candidate outcome, or manually established family identity.
source_rank.stability: Booleans are derived solely from frozen population/evidence sources during S2B; no post-hoc tuning is permitted.
source_rank.ties: source_rank tuple ASC, then mint ASC, then create_creator ASC.
